title: Affine moment derivative expression
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite type, let $r,c,t\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. Define the associated expression as the expectation over $x\in\Omega$ of $rcX(x)(1+ctX(x))^{r-1}$.
